name: Music City Fall 2017
information:
![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/5HAdfpD.png)
To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, 4x4, 6x6, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves, 3x3 One-Handed, 3x3 With Feet, Megaminx, Pyraminx, and 3x3 Multi-blind.
